Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Webhook::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enables tenant-safe CareOnCloud lifecycle webhook subscriptions.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Webhook::ScanBatchSize
Setting.Description: Maximum audit events scanned per active subscription and run.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Webhook::BacklogWarningCount
Setting.Description: Pending and retry lifecycle deliveries that raise a webhook health warning.

Setting.Name: CareOnCloud::Webhook::OldestPendingWarningMinutes
Setting.Description: Age in minutes of the oldest ready lifecycle delivery that raises a warning.

Setting.Name: Daemon::SchedulerCronTaskManager::Task###CareOnCloudWebhookScan
Setting.Description: Scan immutable audit events into the shared signed-delivery outbox every minute.
